litematica-printer.bedrock.creative_mode: Bedrock mode cannot be used in creative mode!
litematica-printer.bedrock.mod_missing: Fabric-Bedrock-Miner/Block-Miner mod not installed, cannot break bedrock!
litematica-printer.block.mismatch: Block %s has mismatched block below, skipping placement
litematica-printer.block.no_support: Block %s has no support below, skipping placement
litematica-printer.config.bedrock.desc: Invoke BedrockMiner mod to achieve bedrock mining. This feature is unavailable if the mod is not installed.
litematica-printer.config.bedrockEnabled: Toggle for the bedrock breaking module.
litematica-printer.config.breakBlocksPer: Maximum number of block jobs handled by each bedrock-breaking dispatch. Set to §b0§r for no limit. This does not control breaking jobs submitted by Print to ChainVein.
Retry cooldown, in game ticks, after Print submits a ChainVein break or breaks ice at the same position.
Interval, in game ticks, between bedrock-breaking dispatches. Set to 0 to allow execution every game tick.
litematica-printer.config.cycleMode.desc: Cycle through working modes in order: Print → Fill → Fluid → Bedrock.
litematica-printer.config.debugOutput.de:
When enabled, console will output printer debug information.
If §6§lShow Work Status§r is also enabled, some information will also be displayed in the operation interface.
litematica-printer.config.easyPlaceProto:
Use Servex's easy place protocol to handle block placement correction during printing.
§lNote:§r This feature only works in single-player or on servers with Servux installed.
litematica-printer.config.servuxHandConf: After switching items, wait for Servux to confirm the server-authoritative main hand before printing. The printer pauses if Servux is unavailable.
litematica-printer.message.servuxHandCon: Servux hand confirmation is enabled, but no compatible Servux server is available.
litematica-printer.config.fill.desc: Within the selection range, place blocks configured in §6Fill Block List§r.
Block list used by filling mode, configuration rules consistent with "Basic Block List".
litematica-printer.config.fillHandheldBl:
In held item mode, items in this list are prohibited from being used for filling, preventing accidental use of fireworks etc.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:firework_rocket§r §bfirework§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:boats§r.
Input text and filter conditions simultaneously (separated by English comma), example: §lfirework,c§r.
Where "c" represents contains matching, prioritizing pinyin or direct matching.
Block selection mode for filling.
§dBlock List§r: Use blocks in configured list
§dHeld Item§r: Use currently held block in main hand
litematica-printer.config.fillModeFacing: Facing settings when filling blocks. For example, placing upper slabs or lower slabs.
litematica-printer.config.fillSelectionT:
Fill area rules:
§dFull Projection§r: Fill across the entire projection
§dVisible Area§r: Only fill within Litematica's currently visible area
§dBelow Player§r: Only process areas below player height
§dAbove Player§r: Only process areas above player height
litematica-printer.config.fluid.desc: At lava sources and water sources positions, default place blocks configured in §6Fluid Replacement Block List§r.
litematica-printer.config.fluidEnabled.d: Toggle for the fluid removal module.
litematica-printer.config.fluidList.desc: List of liquids that need to be replaced, can only input liquid IDs, example: §bminecraft:water§r.
litematica-printer.config.fluidModeFillF: When enabled, flowing liquids will also be treated as targets needing filling and replacement.
litematica-printer.config.fluidReplaceBl:
Block list for filling liquids. Can input item ID or displayed name, example: §bminecraft:sand§r §bsand§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:sand§r.
litematica-printer.config.fluidSelection:
Fluid removal area rules:
§dFull Projection§r: Remove fluid across the entire projection
§dVisible Area§r: Only remove fluid within Litematica's currently visible area
§dBelow Player§r: Only process areas below player height
§dAbove Player§r: Only process areas above player height
litematica-printer.config.highlightColor: Color with alpha (hex AARRGGBB). Example: §b80FF0000§r for 50% red
Color for successful block placement (hex AARRGGBB)
litematica-printer.config.highlightEnabl: Highlight blocks being processed during printing
litematica-printer.config.highlightFadeD: Fade-out duration after placement (units of 0.1s. 10 = 1 second)
litematica-printer.config.highlightThrou: Allow highlights to be visible through blocks
litematica-printer.config.iterationTimeL:
Maximum time for block iteration per game tick (milliseconds).
Set to 0 to disable.
Default 10 ms balances performance and speed, adjust as needed.
Maximum worker threads used by asynchronous block search. Actual usage never exceeds the number of small snapshot tiles, and no new scan round is submitted while the pool is busy.
litematica-printer.config.missingMateria: Show missing materials HUD overlay in Litematica's material list area
litematica-printer.config.openScreen.des: Hotkey to open printer settings menu (the page you're currently viewing).
litematica-printer.config.placeBlocksPer: Maximum number of Print, Fill, or Fluid jobs handled per dispatch. Print jobs include placement, use/adjust actions, and breaking submitted to ChainVein. Set to §b0§r for no limit.
Cooldown time after placing blocks at the same location (in game ticks). Retry placement operation only after cooldown ends.
§c§lDo not set to 0 unless necessary, otherwise it will cause placing extra blocks, inability to place correctly and other issues!§r
litematica-printer.config.placeInAir.des: Ignore block support requirements and place blocks directly in air positions (applicable to unsupported decorative blocks).
Interval, in game ticks, between Print, Fill, and Fluid dispatches. Placement, use/adjust actions, and ChainVein breaking in Print share this interval. Set to 0 to allow execution every game tick.
litematica-printer.config.placeUsePacket:
Use sending placement packets instead of conventional placement logic to reduce "ghost block" phenomenon.
Can try enabling this in environments with packet restrictions.
litematica-printer.config.printAutoFillC:
Automatically fill compostable items into composters to generate bone meal.
(§lWarning: This operation will consume compostable items in inventory!§r)

Compostable items used for automatic composter filling.
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:wheat§r §bwheat§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#compostable§r.
Add ",c" after text for contains matching (prioritizing pinyin/direct matching), example: §lwheat,c§r.
litematica-printer.config.printAutoStrip: When enabled, if stripped logs are not in inventory, will first place normal logs, then automatically strip them with axe to save manual operation time.
litematica-printer.config.printAutoTunin: When printing note blocks, automatically tune note blocks to the pitch specified in schematic.
litematica-printer.config.printBonemealC: Use bone meal to grow crops.
litematica-printer.config.printBreakExtr: Automatically break extra blocks that don't exist in schematic during printing.
litematica-printer.config.printBreakWron: Automatically break blocks that completely mismatch the schematic during printing.

Automatically break blocks whose type matches schematic but state doesn't, and need to be broken for adjustment during printing.
Examples: stairs/slabs with wrong orientation, vines with extra faces, etc.; blocks that can be corrected by clicking (like trapdoors, campfires) won't be broken.
litematica-printer.config.printFallingBl: When enabled, will check if blocks below falling blocks match schematic, and skip placement if incorrect.
litematica-printer.config.printForcedSne: Automatically maintain sneaking state during printing process.
litematica-printer.config.printIceForWat: Generate water source blocks through "place ice → break ice" method to achieve water source printing.
litematica-printer.config.printReplace.d: Directly overwrite blocks in list without skipping processing or breaking.
litematica-printer.config.printReplaceCo: When printing dead coral, if no dead coral in inventory, use live coral as substitute; if both exist, will prioritize using dead coral.
litematica-printer.config.printReplaceab:
Block list that can be directly overwritten during printing (without breaking original blocks).
Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Add ",c" after text for contains matching, example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
litematica-printer.config.printSafelyObs: Check if suitable for placement before placing observers to avoid accidentally triggering your machines and causing disasters.
litematica-printer.config.printSelection:
Print area rules:
§dFull Projection§r: Print across the entire projection
§dVisible Area§r: Only print within Litematica's currently visible area (render layer + sub-region visibility)
§dBelow Player§r: Only process areas below player height
§dAbove Player§r: Only process areas above player height (default)
litematica-printer.config.printSkip.desc: When enabled, will skip blocks in the list during printing.
Block list skipped during printing. Can input item ID or translated name in current language, example: §bminecraft:stone§r §bsandstone§r.
Prefix §b#§r for tag matching, example: §l#minecraft:logs§r.
Add ",c" after text for contains matching, example: §lglazed_terracotta,c§r.
litematica-printer.config.printerAutoDis: Automatically disable printer when player dies to avoid misoperations after respawning.
litematica-printer.config.printerIterato:
Block iteration order during printing:
§dXYZ§r: X axis first, then Y axis, finally Z axis
§dXZY§r: X axis first, then Z axis, finally Y axis
§dYXZ§r: Y axis first, then X axis, finally Z axis
§dYZX§r: Y axis first, then Z axis, finally X axis
§dZXY§r: Z axis first, then X axis, finally Y axis
§dZYX§r: Z axis first, then Y axis, finally X axis

Area shape for printer block iteration:
§dCube§r: Cube with §6§lWork Radius§r as edge length (recommended value: 3)
§dSphere§r: Sphere with §6§lWork Radius§r as radius (recommended value: 6)
§dOctahedron§r: Octahedron with §6§lWork Radius§r as edge length (recommended value: 6)
litematica-printer.config.printerLagChec: used as the upper limit for lag detection.
litematica-printer.config.printerXAxisRe: When enabled, X axis iteration order changes to largest to smallest.
litematica-printer.config.printerYAxisRe: When enabled, Y axis iteration order changes to largest to smallest.
litematica-printer.config.printerZAxisRe: When enabled, Z axis iteration order changes to largest to smallest.
litematica-printer.config.renderHud.desc:
Display current mode and work progress within range on operation page when printer is working;
If §6§lLag Detection§r is enabled, will show prompt when lag is excessive.
litematica-printer.config.returnToShulke: When inventory is full, return the currently held item back to the shulker box slot before taking a new item from it.
litematica-printer.config.shulkerCooldow: Cooldown in ticks before another shulker box can be opened. Range: 0-100.
Choose shulker box support type: Mod (Quick Shulker client-side mod), Plugin (AxShulkers server-side plugin), or TakeItOut (server-side mod).
litematica-printer.config.updateCheck.de: Automatically check for mod updates when first entering world.
litematica-printer.config.useQuickShulke: When materials are missing from inventory but available inside open shulker boxes (via Quick Shulker mod), automatically take items from them.
litematica-printer.config.workRange.desc:
Printer's maximum work radius centered on player (blocks).
§a0 (default)§r: Auto-uses player's reach (creative §b6§r, survival §b4.5§r, server-enforced).
§a> 0§r: Custom override (may exceed server limits).
This parameter is associated with §6§lIteration Area Shape§r.
litematica-printer.free_notice: This mod requires further i18n and l10n. If you do, thank you!
litematica-printer.hud.missing.title: §cMissing: §e%d §7types
litematica-printer.ice.creative_mode: Breaking ice in creative mode will not produce water!
litematica-printer.update.available: Litematica Printer detected new version! Current version: %s, latest version: %s
litematica-printer.update.download: >> Click here to download latest version <<
litematica-printer.update.failed: Update check failed, please try again later.
litematica-printer.update.recommendation: Strongly recommend upgrading to latest version to fix potential serious issues.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.litematic: An extension for Litematica that adds the missing printer functionality, allowing you to automatically build schematics.
litematica-printer.bedrock.not_support: Not supported in original Bedrock Miner, please use bunnyi port version
